postcards.subject: Wondering & Wishing
postcards.message:
Hey!
I hope you're having fun in London. I wonder what you must be thinking about all the things you're seeing and trying. I hope it's not exhausting you too much, though.
I hope the weather is moody in the best way, that you got to try some authentic fish & chips, and that British people are real. Say hello to the Queen if you see her!

postcards.subject: Pancakes & Pining
postcards.message:
Hello!
I had pancakes for breakfast today. They were not very good. Would not recommend. I wonder if you've had some authentic British fish 'n' chips yet. I have so much I want to ask you. It feels too much, so I guess I'm putting them here. It's strange to miss you more that you're in London, when the cadence hasn't changed much, but I do. I hope you have a good day.

postcards.subject: Rainy Reverie
postcards.message:
Hello!
It's raining here and Hilbert is settling in for a nap as I write this. I hope Haju is doing okay too. I think it's been raining in London as well. Have a good day.

postcards.subject: Sofie, Salami & Studying
postcards.message:
Hey
Sofie and Hilbert are slowly warming up to each other, as you can see.
I'm keeping myself busy. Spent today cooking (made a salami sandwich), studying physics (still in that textbook), thinking about you (hope you have a bright day), painting (a few projects). Sending warmth...

postcards.subject: Papers & Pages
postcards.message:
Hello,
I am guessing this may be the first one you are seeing, as I sent you the link to this today. I'm reading Stone Mattress too (among other books), working on a paper you might find interesting. I've been watching the IEEE Quantum Week online too. Hope you're doing well.
